Name: Azrikam, Father of Hasshub
Summary: Father of Hasshub the Levite, son of Hashabiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:14: Father of Hasshub the Levite, son of Hashabiah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Azrikam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
